evidence: Vulg. Matt. 4.18: ambulāns autem juxtā mare Galilaeae
terms.comment: The Gospels’ name: the sea of Galilaea, Galilee, in the genitive. The vowels of Galilaea are left unmarked as Lewis & Short marks them common.

evidence: Vulg. Joh. 6.1: trāns mare Galilaeae, quod est Tiberiadis
terms.comment: After the town of Tiberias on its shore; Tiberiadis is its genitive.

evidence: Vulg. Luc. 5.1: stābat secus stagnum Gennesareth
terms.comment: Luke calls it a lake, stagnum, not a sea. We write lacus Genesareth and lacus Tiberiadis.

sources: The Vulgate, read in the Latin Library text (thelatinlibrary.com), cited by book, chapter and verse.
